articles.title: SJAA Ephemeris Bulletin
articles.summary: The SJAA Ephemeris Bulletin for January 2026 welcomes the new year by highlighting upcoming celestial events, including a total lunar eclipse in March and a total solar eclipse in August, alongside encouraging participation in SJAA elections. It features Messier 42, the Orion Nebula, as the 'Target of the Month,' providing detailed observational history and physical characteristics. Additionally, the bulletin announces a new 'Weekly Newsletter' launched to keep members informed between Bulletin issues.
